newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Intertech sees earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Intertech sees earnings rise.

text.p: Commercial Intertech Corp said on Wednesday said it is on track for meeting its goals of double digit earnings and revenues growth for 1997, since demand remains strong for all of its product lines.

"Our bookings year-to-date, the majority of which will be shipped prior to the close of our fiscal year, are up 26 percent while ending backlog as of April 30 is up 33 percent since the beginning of the fiscal year," chairman, president and chief executive Paul Powers said in a statement.
For its year ended October 31, 1996, the company reported net income of $17.3 million, or $0.95 a fully diluted share, on sales of $465.2 million.
